facts.fact: INE released preliminary results of RGPH4 on 23 July 2026 after data collection closed: 2,191,300 residents (raw base 2,246,300), 304,939 households, 559,303 dwellings and 376,258 buildings; the enumeration date is not given.

facts.fact: UNFPA reports the field enumeration of RGPH-4 was launched on 1 June 2026, scheduled to run 1 to 21 June, using CAPI tablets across 46 sectors, 145 enumeration areas and 2,987 census zones.

Before the count the document reports over 5,000 field agents trained, 350 national trainers and nine regional statistical offices equipped, with the country mapped into 46 sectors, 145 enumeration areas and 2,987 census zones.
INE-GB launched its official recruitment platform for RGPH4 on 2 September 2025, seeking about 5,000 enumerators, supervisors and regional coordinators, financed by the World Bank with UNFPA support.
